 Block Rockin’ Beats Live at King John’s Castle for May Bank Holiday Weekend
 By Eric Fitzgerald - November 16, 2026 
 Share 
 Facebook X WhatsApp Linkedin ReddIt Email Copy URL 
 Advertisement 
 DEC Pierce’s Block Rockin’ Beats will return to King John’s Castle on Sunday May 2, 2027 , as part of the May Bank Holiday Weekend.
 The live dance show, which celebrates the biggest anthems of The Prodigy, Faithless, Underworld, The Chemical Brothers and more, will be performed by a full live band and special guest vocalists against the backdrop of the historic castle.
 Created by Today FM presenter Dec Pierce, Block Rockin’ Beats grew from a popular radio show into one of Ireland’s most successful live dance music experiences. Combining the biggest anthems of the 90s and beyond with powerful live instrumentation and high-end production, it has become a standout attraction at venues and festivals nationwide.
 Following a series of successful headline performances, Dec Pierce and his band will bring their high-energy show back to Limerick for what is expected to be one of the highlights of the bank holiday weekend.

 “The show is all about energy, nostalgia and fun. We want you to completely lose yourself for a few hours,” Dec Pierce said. “It’s more than a gig, it’s a trip back through the anthems that shaped us, powered by a full live band and incredible guest vocalists. When the crowd meets the band at full tilt, it’s pure magic.”
 Mick Dolan said the show has always gone down well with local audiences.
 “Block Rockin’ Beats has always been a fantastic show for Limerick audiences. Dec and the band create an incredible atmosphere, and bringing that energy back to King John’s Castle on the May Bank Holiday Weekend is something we’re really looking forward to. It’s going to be a brilliant night.”
 Tickets go on sale on Friday November 20 at 10am.
